name: Doorway
description: The first clip opens like double doors toward the viewer while the second comes forward from behind, with a floor reflection. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: reflection
params.description: Strength of the floor reflection under the second clip

params.name: perspective
params.description: Amount of perspective on the doors

params.name: depth
params.description: How far back the second clip starts (1: no distance)
